entries.question: Appointment ke liye Kya karna hoga
entries.answer:
KGMU OPD में अपॉइंटमेंट (पर्ची) लेने के लिए निम्नलिखित तरीकों में से किसी एक का उपयोग किया जा सकता है:

1. **ऑनलाइन बुकिंग (ORS पोर्टल):**
   - वेबसाइट [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) पर जाएं।
   - राज्य (Uttar Pradesh) और अस्पताल (KGMU) का चयन करें।
   - 'New Appointment' पर क्लिक करके विभाग, तारीख और समय चुनें।
   - मरीज का विवरण भरकर ₹50 का ऑनलाइन भुगतान करें और पर्ची डाउनलोड करें।

2. **आयुष्मान भारत डिजिटल हेल्थ (ABHA) ऐप:**
   - मोबाइल नंबर और OTP के माध्यम से रजिस्टर करके इसी प्रकार अस्पताल और विभाग का चयन करें।

3. **SMS द्वारा:**
   - `Appointment [Patient Name]` लिखकर **8887019134** पर भेजें।

4. **वॉक-इन (अस्पताल आकर):**
   - अपना आधार कार्ड और सक्रिय मोबाइल नंबर लेकर आएं। 
   - काउंटर पर OTP के जरिए फिजिकल टोकन लें और ₹50 का भुगतान करके OPD पर्ची प्राप्त करें।

**महत्वपूर्ण बातें:**
- ऑनलाइन या अन्य माध्यमों से बुकिंग करने पर OPD पर्ची का शुल्क **₹50** है।
- शहर से बाहर के मरीजों को संबंधित विभाग के लिए वैध रेफरल (Referral) पत्र लाना अनिवार्य है।
- पर्ची काउंटर दोपहर 1:00 बजे बंद हो जाता है। भीड़ से बचने के लिए पूर्व-बुकिंग (Pre-booking) की सलाह दी जाती है। 
- अधिक जानकारी के लिए [KGMU वेबसाइट](https://www.kgmu.org) देख सकते हैं।

entries.question: Appointment in cardiology
entries.answer:
To book an OPD appointment for Cardiology at KGMU (Lari Cardiology), you can use any of the following methods. Online pre-booking is strongly recommended, and online registration is mandatory.

### Booking Methods
1. **Online (ORS Portal):** Visit [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in), select Uttar Pradesh, choose KGMU, select the Cardiology department/date, enter patient details, and pay the ₹50 OPD slip fee to download your slip.
2. **Mobile App:** Use the ABHA / Health Care App, register with your mobile number and OTP, and follow the same hospital selection flow.
3. **SMS:** Send an SMS in the format `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` to **8887019134**.
4. **Walk-in:** Visit the hospital with your Aadhaar number and active mobile number to generate a physical token via OTP, pay the ₹50 fee, and collect your OPD slip. *(Note: Cardiology/Lari patients from outside Lucknow must bring a valid referral from a medical officer or physician).*

### Timings & Fees
- **OPD Timings:** Monday to Friday (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM), Saturday (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM), closed on Sundays.
- **Parchi Counter:** Closes at 1:00 PM sharp.
- **OPD Fee:** ₹50 for all booking methods.

### Emergency Care
For urgent or critical cardiac emergencies, please go directly to the Trauma Centre for initial stabilization, after which patients are transferred across the road to Lari Cardiology. 

For further assistance, you can contact the Lari Cardiology PRO Office at **9415099528**.

entries.question: Liver smndhit jankari lena chahte
entries.answer:

1. **Surgical Gastroenterology Vibhag:** Liver transplant, hepato-biliary aur liver ki surgery ke liye.

**OPD aur Appointment ki Jankari:**
- OPD mein dikhane ke liye online panjikaran (registration) anivarya hai.
- Aap **[ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in)** ya ABHA app ke madhyam se appointment le sakte hain.

- Parchi counter dopahar 1:00 baje sharp band ho jata hai.

*Salah: Kisi bhi prakar ki medical salah ya dawa ke liye kripya KGMU ke qualified doctor ya OPD se sampark karein.*

- **SMS:** Send `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` to **8887019134**.

entries.question: OPD appointment
entries.answer:
To book an OPD appointment at King George's Medical University (KGMU), online pre-booking is strongly recommended. 

### Booking Methods
1. **Online (ORS Portal):** Visit [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in), select Uttar Pradesh, choose KGMU, select the required department and date, enter patient details, pay the ₹50 OPD slip fee, and download your slip.
2. **Mobile App:** Use the ABHA / Health Care App, register with your mobile number and OTP, and follow the same hospital selection flow.
3. **SMS:** Send an SMS in the format `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` to **8887019134**.
4. **Walk-in:** Visit the hospital with your Aadhaar number and active mobile number to generate a physical token via OTP, pay the ₹50 fee, and collect your OPD slip.

### OPD Timings & Guidelines
- **Timings:** Monday to Friday (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM), Saturday (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM), closed on Sundays.
- **Ticket Counter:** The parchi/ticket counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp.
- **Referrals:** Patients from outside Lucknow must bring a valid referral for the specific department.
- **Fees:** ₹50 for all booking methods.

For general inquiries, you can contact the Main PRO Office at **9415007710** or call the helpline at **0522-2258880** / **0522-3539333**.

entries.question: How to ragistration a patient
entries.answer:
To register a patient for OPD consultation at King George's Medical University (KGMU), online registration is mandatory. You can use any of the following methods:

1. **Online Registration System (ORS):** Visit [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in), select Uttar Pradesh, choose KGMU, select the desired department and date, fill in patient details, pay the ₹50 registration fee, and download the slip.
2. **ABHA / Health Care App:** Register using your mobile number and OTP, then follow the same hospital selection flow.
3. **SMS:** Send `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` to **8887019134**.
4. **Walk-in (Offline Counter):** Bring your Aadhaar number and an active mobile number to complete OTP verification at the counter, pay the ₹50 fee, and collect your physical token/OPD slip. 

*Note:* Pre-booking is strongly recommended, and ticket counters close sharp at 1:00 PM. Outside-city patients should bring a valid referral for specific departments.
